ideas.pitch: An AI-powered coordination platform connecting isolated seniors in Newark and surrounding areas with nearby student volunteers for grocery runs and medical appointments.
ideas.title: Delaware Local Senior Care Network
ideas.why_it_could_win: Mirrors the exact grand prize-winning pattern of tackling clear, measurable social impact by solving local community isolation.

ideas.pitch: An AI-powered meal recommendation and nutritional tracking platform tailored specifically to university dining hall menus and student dietary restrictions.
ideas.title: Campus Dining Nutrition & Allergen Optimizer
ideas.why_it_could_win: Targets a problem the judges feel themselves on a daily basis: navigating campus food options with specific health goals.

ideas.pitch: A lightweight compliance and risk detection platform utilizing graph intelligence to help small business owners in Delaware screen transaction partners.
ideas.title: Local Business AML and Risk Inspector
ideas.why_it_could_win: Demonstrates genuinely hard engineering by adapting graph-based risk models into an accessible local business dashboard.

ideas.pitch: An autonomous AI agent marketplace with secure crypto-escrow payments designed to fund student club projects and hackathon teams transparently.
ideas.title: Autonomous Campus Micro-Grant Escrow
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages decentralized escrow mechanics to automate trust in student-led funding initiatives.

ideas.pitch: An AI-powered satellite monitoring tool designed to track zoning compliance and environmental changes on industrial properties in New Castle County.
ideas.title: Industrial Land Compliance Satellite Monitor
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines spatial data visualization with automated compliance reporting, standing out through technical complexity.
